title: fix(plugin-detail): a record:chatter or record:discussion whose feed.types leaves out comment offers no comment composer
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi99ewj5JRWXTB3u38E9HLhnj)_
Fixes #34525

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmSYVw1sqCsaHSJS9JC

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:`record:chatter` 和 `record:discussion` 的 `feed.types` 不含 `comment` 时，不再显示评论输入框和「仅评论」筛选项;开发环境下对每个块提示一次原因和两种改法。判定与 `record:activity` 共用同一个函数 `feedTypesAdmitComments`。
- **为什么改**:`record:activity` 已按此规则收掉输入框，但两个讨论块没有把判定传给时间线，时间线默认当作「能显示评论」,用户在这里发的评论保存后立刻被 `types` 过滤掉，看起来像丢了。
- **风险与回滚**:只影响 `feed.types` 写了且不含 `comment` 的讨论块;没写 `types` 或含 `comment` 的块、宿主自动追加的讨论区完全不变。`RecordChatterPanel` 新增的 `commentsShown` 是可选 prop,不传即 `true`。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/record-chatter.tsx`(判定、开发期提示、传参);`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RecordChatterPanel.tsx`(新 prop 透传给两处时间线);`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/__tests__/recordFeedDiagnosticBlockName-9557.test.tsx`(被迫改动的一条旧测试)。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/__tests__/recordChatterFeedMembersLive-8934.test.tsx`,预期 33 个全过，其中 8 个是本卡新增(两种块各 4 个)。
- **需要你做的**:无，席位落地。

## What changes

`record:activity` withholds the comment composer and the Comments-only filter when its `types` leaves out `comment` (the `commentsShown` prop on `RecordActivityTimeline`, computed by `feedTypesAdmitComments`). `record:chatter` and `record:discussion` render the same timeline through `RecordChatterPanel` and filter their rows by `feed.types` through the same `applyFeedConfig`, but handed the timeline no `commentsShown`, so it defaulted to `true`: a feed authored `feed: { types: ['task'] }` still offered the composer, and a posted comment was stored and then filtered out of that same feed.

- `renderers/record-chatter.tsx`: computes `commentsShown` with `feedTypesAdmitComments(feed?.types, blockName)`, the same predicate and the same block name its `applyFeedConfig` call filters by, so the answer and the rows cannot disagree; hands it to the panel. Where the composer would otherwise have been offered (`feed.showCommentInput` not `false`), it raises `warnWithheldCommentComposer` once per block from an effect, in development only (the package's per-file `isDevBuild` spelling), scoped `BLOCK feed` the way this file's row-limit refusal is.
- `RecordChatterPanel.tsx`: one optional prop, `commentsShown`, forwarded to the timeline in both layouts (sidebar and inline). Absent means `true`, so a host that composes the panel itself and does not filter by `feed.types` is unchanged.
- `.changeset/34525-chatter-comments-shown.md`: `@object-ui/plugin-detail` patch.

A feed with no `types`, or a `types` that includes `'comment'`, renders exactly as before; the host's auto-appended discussion mounts the renderer with no `types` and is unchanged.

## Tests

New top-level `describe.each` over both block names in the chatter feed harness, `renderers/__tests__/recordChatterFeedMembersLive-8934.test.tsx` (renderer resolved through `ComponentRegistry`, node `type` stated, real panel and timeline, a host `DiscussionContext` with `onAddComment`):

- `types: ['task']` draws no composer and no Comments Only option, renders only the task row, and warns once under `BLOCK feed`;
- CONTROL `types: ['task', 'comment']`: composer and option stay, comments show, no warning;
- CONTROL no `types`: the same;
- `showCommentInput: false` with `types: ['task']`: no warning.

**Forced test edit (one):** `renderers/__tests__/recordFeedDiagnosticBlockName-9557.test.tsx`, leg `NO-FOREIGN-NAME`. It mounts a `record:discussion` with `feed.types: ['crm_task']` and counted every warning containing `crm_task`; the new withheld-composer warning quotes the same `types`, so the count went 1 to 2. The leg now counts the unrecognised-entry channel it is about, and still holds every message containing `crm_task` under `[record:discussion` with no `[record:activity]`.

<details><summary>Pin run and ablations (fix commit 3da4e3c5)</summary>

- Pin file on 3da4e3c5: Tests 33 passed (33), lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- Ablation 1, `record-chatter.tsx`, the `commentsShown={commentsShown}` pass-through deleted through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 to 0, blob d6a89c65 to d4348647): Tests 2 failed, 31 passed; the `types: [task]` pin went red under both `record:chatter` and `record:discussion` ("expected TEXTAREA to be null"); the controls stayed green. Restored: blob equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Ablation 2, `RecordChatterPanel.tsx`, both forwards deleted (`--expect 2`, anchor 2 to 0): Tests 2 failed, 31 passed, the same two pins. Restored: blob equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- The pins import the renderer and the registry from `src` (relative imports; `@object-ui/react` maps to its `src` through the root vitest alias table), so no `dist` rebuild sits between a mutation and the run.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The withheld-composer warning text says `types` and `showCommentInput`; on these two blocks both keys sit under `feed`, which the `BLOCK feed` scope names. The text is shared with `record:activity` and was not forked.
- Hosts that mount `RecordChatterPanel` directly pass their own items and do no `types` filtering, so the default `true` keeps them as they were.
